title: Create Video Shopping Ads with products from Showcase
content_data:
Showcase is a feature on TikTok that allows customers to shop directly from a seller’s or a creator’s account. You can find the Showcase tab when tapping the shopping bag icon on the profile page of a TikTok account. Showcase displays products from a single TikTok Shop or multiple TikTok Shops. You can learn more about how to use Showcase [here](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article?aid=10013245&redirected=1). This article introduces how to create Video Shopping Ads with products from Showcase. > **Note**
>
  • The flags of Required/ Conditional in the following parameter tables are only applicable for Video Shopping Ads with products from Showcase.
  • Creating Video Shopping Ads with products from Showcase is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative.
## 1.Create a campaign Create a campaign using `/campaign/create/`. The following table only lists the parameters related to Shopping Ads. To find out the other parameters required for creating campaigns, refer to [/campaign/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739318962329602). > **Note**
> Currently, Campaign Budget Optimization is not supported for Shopping Ads with products from Showcase. ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| | advertiser_id{Required} | string | Advertiser ID | | objective_type{Required} | string | Advertising objective.
Use `PRODUCT_SALES` for Shopping Ads. | | budget_mode{+Conditional} | string | How you'd like to set your budget, and for example you can set daily budget. Requied when `objective_type` is NOT `RF_REACH`. When `objective_type` is `RF_REACH`, `budget_mode` only supports `BUDGET_MODE_INFINITE`.
To learn about how to set budget modes, see [Budget](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739381246298114). | | budget{+Conditional} | float | Campaign budget. Required when `budget_mode` is `BUDGET_MODE_DAY` or `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET` or `BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL`.
To learn about the minimum budget and how to set budget types, see [Budget](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739381246298114). | | campaign_name{Required} | string | Campaign name. It can contain up to 512 characters. Emoji is not supported.

Note: Each word in Chinese or Japanese counts as two characters, while each letter in English counts as one character. | | campaign_product_source {Required} | string | Product source of the Video Shopping campaign.
Set this field to `STORE` (TikTok Shop, or TikTok Showcase). | ``` ### Example #### Request ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/campaign/create/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data-raw '{ "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "budget_mode": "BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL", "objective_type": "PRODUCT_SALES", "campaign_product_source": "STORE", "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "budget": 5000 }' (/code) ``` #### Response ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "budget": 5000.0, "campaign_type": "REGULAR_CAMPAIGN", "campaign_product_source": "STORE", "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "campaign_app_profile_page_state": "UNSET", "roas_bid": 0.0, "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "budget_mode": "BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL", "objective": "LANDING_PAGE", "secondary_status": "CAMPAIGN_STATUS_ENABLE", "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "deep_bid_type": null, "is_new_structure": true, "operation_status": "ENABLE", "modify_time": "{{modify_time}}", "objective_type": "PRODUCT_SALES", "is_smart_performance_campaign": false } } (/code) ``` ## 2.Create a valid Showcase identity and get necessary permissions You will use the identity of the Showcase to create a Video Shopping Ad Group, and need to ensure that the following prerequisites are all met: - Bind the Showcase that you want to use for creating the Video Shopping Ad Group to a TikTok User or TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.
When the TikTok User or TikTok Account User in Business Center identity is created, the Showcase of the TikTok account is bound to that identity. See [Identities](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738958351620097) to learn more about different identity types, and see [Create Spark Ads](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739470744631298) to find out how you can create the TikTok User or TikTok Account User in Business Center identity and use the identity to create Spark Ads. Note that Video Shopping Ads created with products from Showcases are all Spark Ads. - Your ad account has obtained the permission of the Showcase.
See [here](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/how-to-get-showcase-permission?lang=en) to learn about how to get Showcase permissions. - Your ad account has been allowlisted to create Video Shopping Ads with products from Showcase.
If you would like to access the allowlist-only feature, please contact your TikTok representative. ## 3.Get details of the Showcase Note that the details of the Showcase will be used during ad group creation and ad creation. i. Call [/showcase/identity/get/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1759233549899778) to get the identity of the Showcase.
ii. Call [/showcase/region/get/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1759233561597954) to get the available country or region that the Showcase can target.
iii. Call [/showcase/product/get/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1759233576199169) to get the Showcase products that can be used for the country or region you want to target. ## 4.Create an ad group Create an ad group using `/adgroup/create/`. The following table only lists the parameters related to Shopping Ads. To find out the other parameters required for creating ad groups, refer to [/adgroup/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739499616346114).
Set the fields `identity_id`, `identity_type`, `location_ids` and optionally `identity_authorized_bc_id` according to the results from Step 3.i-ii. >**Note**
>

  • Automated Creative Optimization is not supported for Shopping Ads.
  • The following parameters will be ignored if passed in:
    • catalog_id
    • product_set_id
    • catalog_authorized_bc_id
    • store_id
    • store_authorized_bc_id
``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| | promotion_type{Required} | string | Promotion type and you can decide where you'd like to promote your products using this field.
Use `VIDEO_SHOPPING` for Video Shopping Ads. | |placement_type |string|The placement strategy that decides where your ads will be shown.

Enum values:
  • `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`: Automatic placement. TikTok's ad system will use smart calculations to give you the best combination of ad placements across all apps.
  • `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL`: Select placement. By selecting your placement manually, you'll be able to choose the apps to deliver your ads on.

Default value: `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL`.

Note: Pangle placement (`PLACEMENT_PANGLE`) for Video Shopping Ads for Shop (`product_source` as `STORE` or `SHOWCASE`) is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative. Once you are allowlisted for this feature, you can also use automatic placement (`PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`) for Video Shopping Ads for Shop. | |placements {+Conditional}|string[]|

  • When `placement_type` is `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL`, this field is required.
  • When `placement_type` is `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`, this field is ignored and overwritten to the combination of ad placements that the TikTok ad system selects for your ad.

The apps where you want to deliver your ads.

Enum values: `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`, `PLACEMENT_PANGLE`.

Note: Pangle placement (`PLACEMENT_PANGLE`) for Video Shopping Ads for Shop is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative.| | product_source {Required} | string | Product source where you want to get products for promotion.
Enum values: `UNSET`, `CATALOG` (Catalog), `STORE` (TikTok Shop), `SHOWCASE` (TikTok Showcase).
You need to specify this field as `SHOWCASE`.

Note: If `campaign_product_source` is not set at the campaign level, and you have at least one historical ad group with `product_source` set as `CATALOG` and one with `product_source` set as `STORE` or `SHOWCASE` under the same campaign at the same time, you cannot create new ad groups under the campaign.| | shopping_ads_type{Required} | string | Shopping ads type. Enum values: `VIDEO` (Video Shopping Ads), `LIVE` (Live Shopping Ads).
Use `VIDEO` for Video Shopping Ads. | | identity_id {Required} | string | The ID of the identity that the Showcase that you want to use for your ad is bound to.
You can use [/showcase/identity/get/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1759233549899778) to get the identity of a Showcase. | | identity_type {Required} | string | Identity type.
The allowed enum values: `TT_USER` (TikTok User), `BC_AUTH_TT` (TikTok Account User in Business Center). See [Identities](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738958351620097) for details. | | identity_authorized_bc_id {+Conditional} | string | Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`.
ID of the Business Center that a TikTok Account User in Business Center identity is associated with. | | location_ids {Required} | string[] | IDs of the locations that you want to target. To get the list of location IDs, see [Location IDs](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739311040498689).
The targeted locations should belong to the country or region that the Showcase can target.
To get the available country or region that the Showcase can target, use the [/showcase/region/get/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1759233561597954)endpoint.

Note:

  • If you add US as your target location, then you can not remove US after ad group creation.
| | optimization_goal{Required} | string | The measurable results you'd like to drive with your ads.
The allowed enum values: `CLICK` (Click), `CONVERT` (Conversion), `VALUE` (Value). | | optimization_event{+Conditional} | string | Required when `optimization_goal` = `CONVERT`.
Conversion event for the ad group. The allowed enum values: `INITIATE_ORDER` (Initiate Checkout), `SHOPPING` (Complete Payment).

Note: When `optimization_goal` =`CLICK` or `VALUE` , you don't need to set this field. | | billing_event{Required} | string | Events that you want to pay for. The allowed enum values: `CPC`, `OCPM`.

  • When `optimization_goal` is `CLICK`, set this field to `CPC`.
  • When `optimization_goal` is `CONVERT` or `VALUE`, set this field to `OCPM`.
| | bid_type {Required} | string | Bidding strategy that determines how the system manages your cost per result, spends your budget, and how it delivers ads.

Enum values:
  • `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM`: Keep the average cost per result around the stated amount. This bidding strategy is called Target CPA or Cost Cap in TikTok Ads Manager.
  • `BID_TYPE_NO_BID`: Aim to spend your entire budget to get the most results. This bidding strategy is called Maximum Delivery in TikTok Ads Manager.
| | deep_bid_type{+Conditional} | string | Required when `optimization_goal` is `VALUE`.

Bidding strategy for [Value-Based Optimization](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739381743067137) that determines how the system manages your cost per result, spends your budget, and how it delivers ads.

Enum values:
  • `VO_MIN_ROAS`: Keep the average ROAS around the stated amount. This bidding strategy is called Target ROAS in TikTok Ads Manager.
  • `VO_HIGHEST_VALUE`: Aim to spend your entire budget to get the most gross revenue. This bidding strategy is called Highest Gross Revenue in TikTok Ads Manager.
| | roas_bid{+Conditional} | float | Required when `deep_bid_type` is `VO_MIN_ROAS`.
ROAS goal for Value Optimization.
Value range: 0.01-1000. | ``` ### Example #### Request ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/adgroup/create/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data-raw '{ "adgroup_name": "{{adgroup_name}}", "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "product_source": "SHOWCASE", "promotion_type": "VIDEO_SHOPPING", "shopping_ads_type":"VIDEO", "identity_type": "BC_AUTH_TT", "identity_id": "{{identity_id}}", "identity_authorized_bc_id": "{{identity_authorized_bc_id}}", "placement_type": "PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL", "placements": [ "PLACEMENT_TIKTOK" ], "location_ids": [ "{{location_ids}}" ], "optimization_goal": "CLICK", "bid_type": "BID_TYPE_NO_BID", "billing_event": "CPC", "schedule_end_time": "{{schedule_end_time}}", "schedule_start_time": "{{schedule_start_time}}", "schedule_type": "SCHEDULE_START_END", "shopping_ads_retargeting_type": "OFF", "targeting_expansion": { "enable_expansion": false }, "video_download_disabled": true, "automated_targeting": "OFF", "budget": 400.0, "budget_mode": "BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL", "gender": "GENDER_UNLIMITED", "ios14_quota_type": "UNOCCUPIED", "operation_status": "ENABLE", "pacing": "PACING_MODE_SMOOTH", }' (/code) ``` #### Response ```xcodeblock (code "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "scheduled_budget": 0.0, "rf_estimated_frequency": null, "bid_display_mode": "CPMV", "pixel_id": null, "campaign_name": "{{}}" } } (/code) ``` ## 5.Create an ad Create an ad using `/ad/create/`. The following table only lists the parameters related to Shopping Ads. To find out the other parameters required for creating ads, refer to [/ad/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739953377508354).
Set the fields `showcase_products`, `item_group_id`, `store_id`, `catalog_id` according to the results from Step 3.iii. >**Note**
>
  • Do not pass in page_id when creating a Video Shopping Ad with products from Showcase.
  • The following parameters will be ignored if passed in:
    • catalog_id (the one not in showcase_products)
    • store_id(the one not in showcase_products)
    • store_authorized_bc_id
    • product_specific_type
    • dynamic_format
    • dynamic_destination
``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| | showcase_products {Required} | object[] | The list of Showcase products that you want to use in your ad. Max size: 20.

To retrieve the products within a Showcase and determine whether they can be used in ads, use [/showcase/product/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1759233576199169). If the returned `status` for a product is `AVAILABLE`, you can use the product in ads.| #| item_group_id | string | SPU ID of the product. | #| store_id | string | The ID of the store that the product (`item_group_id`) belongs to.
Note that the only supported store type is TikTok Shop. | #| catalog_id | string | The ID of the catalog that the product (`item_group_id`) belongs to.

Note: Starting June 30th, 2024, you will no longer need to pass this field because it will be ignored.| | identity_id{Required} | string | Identity ID.
Set this field to the same value that you specify at the ad group level. | | identity_type{Required} | string | Identity type.
The allowed enum values: `TT_USER` (TikTok User), `BC_AUTH_TT` (TikTok Account User in Business Center). See [Identities](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738958351620097) for details.
Set this field to the same value that you specify at the ad group level. | | identity_authorized_bc_id{+Conditional} | string | Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`.
ID of the Business Center that a TikTok Account User in Business Center identity is associated with. | | video_id{+Conditional} | string | Required when you want to create a Spark Ad by pushing a video ad to linked Business Account. See [Create Spark Ads-Push a video ad to linked Business Account](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739470744631298) to learn more.
You need to pass in either `video_id` or `tiktok_item_id`.
Video ID. | | tiktok_item_id{+Conditional} | string | Required when you want to create a Spark Ad by pulling organic videos. See [Create Spark Ads](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739470744631298) to learn more.
You need to pass in either `video_id` or `tiktok_item_id`.
The ID of the TikTok post to be used as an ad (Spark Ad).

Note: By using Spark Ads, you confirm that you have the rights to use the music in the videos for commercial purposes. | | vertical_video_strategy{Required} | string | The video type that you use for Product Sales scenarios.
The allowed enum value: `SINGLE_VIDEO` (single video). | | card_id | string | Use this field to pass in the ID of an existing creative portfolio to include a Countdown Sticker or Product Card in your ads.
You need to first call [/creative/portfolio/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739091950439426) to create a Countdown Sticker portfolio, or Product Card portfolio, and get the portfolio ID via the returned `creative_portfolio_id`. | | call_to_action | string | Call-to-action text. For enum values, see [Enumeration - Call-to-Action](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737174886619138).
You can specify this field when:

  • You pass in `card_id`.
Otherwise, this field will be ignored and defaults to `SHOP_NOW`. | ``` ### Example #### Request ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST Preview an ad After the ad is created, preview your ad using [/creative/ads_preview/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739403070695426).
We offer preview types of `ADS_CREATION`, `AD` , `CARD`, and `PAGE` to enable you to preview ads that you plan to create, existing ads, Product Cards, and Instant Pages.
seo_title: Create TikTok Video Shopping Ads with products from Showcase
seo_description: Find out the detailed steps for creating Manual Video Shopping Ads with products from Showcase. Read the guide to help you get the task done right.
